basis: Laptop purchase price SGD1688 reported by Carlo on 9 November 2026; no wall-socket power readings supplied. Other operating inputs remain labeled estimates.

inputs.label: Laptop purchase price (SGD)
inputs.note: Carlo reported actual purchase price SGD1688 on 9 November 2026; same hardware cost across power cases.

inputs.label: Optional UPS capital (SGD)
inputs.note: Planning allowance only; not installed in the tested stack.

inputs.label: Optional backup device capital (SGD)
inputs.note: Planning allowance only; not installed in the tested stack.

inputs.label: Residual at horizon (SGD)
inputs.note: Conservative planning assumption, not observed resale value.

inputs.label: Hardware useful life (months)
inputs.note: Planning horizon, not mandated by lecture.

inputs.label: Operating hours/month
inputs.note: 24/7 planning convention, not measured uptime.

inputs.label: Average wall power (W)
inputs.note: Unmeasured low/base/high assumptions; not CPU TDP, charger rating or Docker CPU percentage.

inputs.label: Electricity tariff incl GST (SGD/kWh)
inputs.note: EMA regulated household tariff for Oct–Dec2026; actual retail contract may differ.

inputs.label: Additional facility multiplier
inputs.note: No dedicated cooling budget. Whole-device wall draw assumed; do not add charger/fan power again.

inputs.label: Annual maintenance / laptop cost
inputs.note: Planning allowance; not a paid warranty quotation.

inputs.label: Administration hours/month
inputs.note: Expanded local budget only; cloud operator labor is excluded from the gross AWS model.

inputs.label: Administration rate (SGD/hour)
inputs.note: Illustrative opportunity cost, not salary survey evidence.

inputs.label: Incremental public-hosting network/month (SGD)
inputs.note: Expanded budget assumption; not a confirmed ISP plan or measured need.

inputs.label: Recurring backup/month (SGD)
inputs.note: Expanded budget assumption, not a purchased backup service.

inputs.label: Additional software/month (SGD)
inputs.note: Prototype assumes existing OS entitlement and no extra paid subscription; commercial licensing needs separate review.

inputs.label: TCO horizon (months)
inputs.note: Constant-use, undiscounted scenario; no tariff or demand escalation.

inputs.label: Hardware allocated to hosting
inputs.note: Dedicated-equivalent view assigns 100%; sharing requires a defensible allocation.

inputs.label: Assumed monthly active users
inputs.note: Business denominator only, not concurrent k6 users or observed users.

inputs.label: Listings
inputs.note: Observed count in both environments; content/version equivalence is separate.

inputs.label: Planning SGD per USD
inputs.note: Illustrative conversion, not a verified exchange-rate quotation.

inputs.label: Assumed cloud GST
inputs.note: Planning gross-up for a consumer comparison; actual billing tax basis unverified.
